content: Pholu yi Balanabasi ku Kikonyumi
Ku Kikonyumi, Pholu yi Balanabasi bakala kota phi mu nzu za kimvuka za Bayuta yi kuzonzilaka mu phila yimosi ni Bayuta balawu yi bisi Ngeleti bákwikila.
Kaasi Bayuta bana bábwisa mu kukwikila, bakala sanda ni bavwadingisa mbundu za Baphani tii yikuna kuyenguna baphangi.

Mbatanana buna, Pholu yi Balanabasi báyika bilumbu bya bawu ku Kikonyumi. Bakala zonza yi kikumbwala kikuma bakala yekamina mwena Pfumu, yandi wuna wakala ta kimbangi kya ndinga ya mamboti mandi mu kuhana bidimbu yi biphadi muna moku ma bawu.
Muna mbanza, batu bádikabisa; bahika kikuma kya Bayuta, bakwawu kikuma kya bathumwa.
Kaasi bwosu bakala yilama, Baphani yi Bayuta yi bapfumu ba bawu, mu kubanyokuna yi kubahondila ku matadi,
bawu buna bábakulabwa, bátina ku mbanza ya Lisiti yi Delebi muna nzunga za kinzunga kya Dikawoni.
Kwakuna, báyandika kulonga Musamu wa Bukheti.
Pholu yi Balanabasi ku Lisiti
Kwákala, kuna Lisiti, yi mutu mosi wawokumuka malu; tuka lubutuku lwandi, kákangalaku keti mbala mosi. Wazakala kákala.
Kakala yuka mana kakala zonza Pholu. Yandu-yandu wumutadi amana bwosu kámona ni kákala yi lukwikilu lwalenda mubelula,
hanga wuzimbudi mu ndinga ya ngolu: «Telama, singika bitambi byaku!» Mutu wuna wásotuka amana wáyandika mu kukangala.
Bwosu bámona mambu mana kásala Pholu, milumba-lumba mya batu báthuta ndinga amana bázimbula mu ndinga ya bawu ya Dikawonye: «Banzambi bavwati lutu lwa kimutu amana bakulungi kwena betu!»
Balanabasi bakala mutela: «Zewusi» amana Pholu: «Helemesi», kikuma yandi wákala ngenzi

Kikumbu kya nzambi Zewusi kyákala kuna fula dya mbanza amana nganga wa kikumbu mekina, kumosi yi mulumba-lumba wa batu, wánata miluma mya bangombi yi bithundu bya kunenga, kázola ni katambikabya kimenga kwena Pholu yi Balanabasi.
Tangwa báyukabwa bathumwa, Pholu yi Balanabasi, báyata miledi
mya bawu amana bénda thinu mu mulumba-lumba mu kukalunga:

«Bakwetu, biki lubati hangila bwabuna? Betu phi thwenina batu hanga benu. Yuka ni tubati lusamwana Musamu wa Bukheti, ndangu lwayambula mambu makonda mupfunu amana lwabaluka kwena Nzambi wa moya wuna wáhanga zilu yi tsi yi yanga dya mbuta, yi bima byosu bina bisimwa zingila.
Muna makula máluta, yandi wáhana nzila kwena makanda moosu mu kulanda nzila za bawu-meni.

Kaasi kálembwaku mu kuta kimbangi, mu kuhangaka mambu ma mamboti; mu kulunokisinaka mvula tukidila ku zilu, amana lwisi hela phi bibundu muna tangwa dya byawu, mu kuluhekaka madya yi kyesi kya ku mbundu.»
Mbatanana bakala zonza bwabuna, phasi bámona mu kukandikisa kwena milumba-lumba mya batu mu kubatambikila kimenga.
Kunima, Bayuta bana bátuka ku Atyosi yi ku Kikonyumi bábalongisila milumba-lumba mya batu. Hanga bamutimbwadi matadi Pholu amana bámubulumuna ku phenza ya mbanza, bábanza ni wafwa kákala.
Kaasi tangwa bámuzyeta balonguki, wátokama amana wávutuka mu mbanza. Kilumbu kyalanda, wénda yi Balanabasi ku Delebi.
Kuvutuka ku Atyoki dya Sidya
Kunima dya kusamuna Musamu wa Bukheti mu mbanza meni yayina yi kuyika balonguki balawu, Pholu yi Balanabasi mu kuvutuka kwa bawu, báhitila ku Lisiti ku Kikonyumi yi ku Atyosi.
Bakala syamisa balonguki yi kubaheka kikesa ndangu bazyama mu lukwikilu, mu kuzimbula: «Bulombi kwena betu, twamona kiwayi kya lawu mu kukota mu Kipfumu kya Nzambi.»
Muna kosu Dibundu, bakala basodila malemba, amana ku manima ma kulombila yi kuzila kudya, bábatambika kwena Pfumu mwena wuna bakala sila lukwikilu lwa bawu.
Kunima, báhyokila ku Phisidiya amana bátula ku Phafidiya.
Ku manima ma kulonga ndinga ya Nzambi ku Phelezi, bákulumuka ku Atadi.
Tangwa bákatuka kwakuna, bálabuka ku Atyosi wa Sidiya, kuna bábatambikila mu khenda za Nzambi, kikuma kya kisalu kina básala.
Buna bátula, bákhundikisa Dibundu amana bátendula mambu moosu mana kábasadila Nzambi, yi buna kákangula mwelu wa lukwikilu kwena Baphani.
Amana bánanga bilumbu bya lawu kumosi yi balonguki.

footnotes.text: Mu ndinga ya Dikawonye yi muna tsi za hika za ngeleti, mwákala yi mikhenda lawu myakala zonzila banzambi bana bisi kituka batu.
Zewusi kenina pfumu wa banzambi ba bisi ngeleti. Bakala mutela phi «tata wa banzambi yi batu» Helemesi kenina ngenzi wa Zewusi.
Báyata miledi mya bawu: yina yenina tsadidi ya Bayuta mu kusongila ni khabu bisi yuka tangwa bisi yuka ngusi zina bisi mutukwana Nzambi.
